name: Serizawa Naoki
source:
Naoki is the protagonist of Yubikiri no Kioku. Naoki used to live at Chinatsu's home but is now living alone. Naoki is a second-year student at the private Tōrin high school.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Memories_Off:_Yubikiri_no_Kioku]Wikipedia[/url].]
